sourceText:
Emily's Baked Ziti
By: Emily Riedemann
Published: Thursday, November 4, 2010 - 8:41am

Ingredients




1 pound ziti
1/2 onion, chopped, for flavor
Ricotta cheese
2 jars pasta sauce
8 ounce bag of shredded mozzarella cheese
Grated Parmesan cheese
Italian seasoning for flavor

Preparation

1 Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add ziti pasta, and cook until al dente, about 8 minutes; drain. 2 Take half of the cooked and drained ziti and put it in a layer in a baking dish. Sprinkle half of the chopped onions in with it. Cover bottom layer with the ricotta cheese, spreading it evenly. (If you want to make this a meaty dish, you could brown some ground beef and mix it into the layers as well.) 3 Take the second half of the ziti and make the second layer. Sprinkle in the rest of the onions. Pour in the 2 jars of pasta sauce; sprinkle in some Italian seasoning for flavor. 4 Top off the ziti bake with the shredded mozzarella. Spread evenly. Sprinkle in some grated Parmesan cheese with the mozzarella topping if desired. 5 Put ziti bake into the oven at 350 degrees and let it bake for 30 – 40 minutes, until the cheese is bubbly and slightly browned.
